thought: Her friends pooled ₹40,000 so she could travel to Delhi. She came back Kerala's first tribal woman IAS officer.
support: Sreedhanya Suresh was born in Wayanad, Kerala, in 1991, to the Kurichiya tribal community - her father worked as a daily wage laborer, and resources for education were scarce throughout her schooling. She studied zoology at Kozhikode and pursued a master's at Calicut University before attempting the UPSC Civil Services Examination three times. When money ran short for her Delhi preparation trip, her friends raised ₹40,000 to help her go. She cleared the exam on her third attempt with All India Rank 410, becoming the first tribal woman from Kerala to pass the Civil Services Examination - and later served as District Collector of Kozhikode.
